dialogOption.texten: 911, what's your emergency?

dialogOption.emotions: excited about the evemt, actually enjoys the scene
dialogOption.texten: Hello? Dude, we have a serious mess here!
{WHAT'S HAPPENING?}Ok, what's happening?
Our boys are beating up the other fans! I thought it's gonna be this kinda, you know, friendly brawl... but our boys are pushing it a bit too far. Can you send an ambulance or somethin'?
{IS ANYONE INJURED?}Is anyone severely injured?
Well, not severely but some of them are pretty messed up. Few are actually unconscious. One of ours as well!
{OURS?}What do you mean by ours?
I'm rootin' for Mets guys obviously! B-but I'm staying out of the fight...
{TELL THEM TO STOP} Can you advise them to stop fighting try to get'em to break it up?
Are you for real! I'm just spectating mate! From safe distance.
{I'LL SEND POLICE}Alright I am gonna have to send the police.
No! No need for that... just an ambulance... well, maybe some firefighters cuz the bus is in flames...
{WHERE?}What's the location of the fight?
Bar on [[ADDRESS]]
Bar on 21 Arthur Avenue
Bar on Christopeher Street
Bar on 5 Maiden Avenue
{WHO IS WINNING?}Who's winning?
Our boys so far! They're really smacking them good!
{HOW MANY FIGHTERS?}How many people are involved in the fight?
Like ten dudes. It's one of those 'too many drinks per head' exchange of arguments thing, you know. And a bit of smoulder... maybe they beat us in the game but we did smoked their bus! Ha!
{IS SOMETHING ON FIRE?}Is something on fire?
That's what I've said, they pushed it a little too far. Oh, you know, we're mourning our loss after that game. I kinda do understand them, wouldn't you mate?
Setting a vehicle on fire and assaulting people, those are crimes...
Oh, you're at work I guess. I just hope I did not spoil you the result of the game... did you record it?
{FOCUS ON THE FIGHT}Can you please focus on the fight?
Well, that's all! Ours are givin' them hell! So far...
{UNITS ARE COMING}Ok, Sir, I've got officers on the way. They gonna break up the fight and deal with the situation.
Be quick about it.
Are you there?

reportElement.texten: Witness reported bar fight between sport fans.
Fight started to expand. Witness refused to take action as he was afraid for his own safety.
In the course of fight suspects set fire to a bus. Firefighter intervention was required.
